description: Use when adding camera controls to a Three.js scene: orbit, pan, zoom, fly, first-person, or object manipulation. Prevents the common mistake of forgetting controls.update() in the render loop, not calling dispose(), or mixing controls. Covers OrbitControls, MapControls, FlyControls, PointerLockControls, TransformControls. Keywords: OrbitControls, controls, camera controls, orbit, pan, zoom, MapControls, FlyControls, PointerLockControls, TransformControls, rotate view, move camera, mouse controls, drag to rotate.
